segments 1007 bytes/row = 1.1x the 904-byte V2 row plus two ordinals; measured overhead was 3.3%
root buckets 960 bytes/row = V2 row + 16-byte digest + 8-byte ordinal + framing; measured exactly V2 row + 24
recursive bucketing assumes 1 additional full repartition; it was never triggered by the registered inputs
descriptor 1/100 bytes per V2 integer per row; measured 0.0098 (61 columns) and 0.0062 (226 columns) bytes, so every shape is rounded up
CSF text 321 bytes/record and CSF Parquet 73 bytes/record; measured 320.05/27.51 and 300.77/72.60, rounded up
publishing copies the staged set to its destinations, so the staged set and the published files exist at the same time
free space is checked with statvfs where the platform provides it; elsewhere it is reported as unchecked rather than assumed sufficient
